thread:
incident-bot: Pager: GPU decode OOM spike on stream-pool-12 (gpu-node-34) detected 11:23 UTC. Auto-quarantine engaged, ~400 reqs affected. Severity: P1.

maria (oncall): on it, joining the channel. pulling telemetry now.

sam (eng-runtime): looking at logs — repeated cudaErrorMemoryAllocation on decode worker pid=2841. KV cache growth + long tail token counts for same request ids. any client-side tokencap overrides?

jordan (sre): I'm seeing a client stream with max_tokens=null / unspecified, server accepted unlimited and generation spiraled. Node memory rising from 30% -> 98% over ~90s.

maria (oncall): can we throttle that route or route to fallback? which route id?

sam (eng-runtime): route=stream-gen-prod. applying emergency route-level tokencap=512 and enabling fallback_model=redwood-small-v1. Patching route now: `PATCH /v1/routes/stream-gen-prod {"tokencap":512, "fallback":"redwood-small-v1"}`

opsbot: Route patch accepted; rolling to 3 replicas. Expected rollout time ~35s.

alyssa (customer-ops): any customer-facing impact? I see ticket #12345 and some CS chats reporting failures starting 11:20 UTC. Need ETA to share.

maria (oncall): impact: enterprise customers on dedicated pool saw ~5-10% request drops for streaming calls during the spike. CS + AE notified. Work in progress.

devin (product-eng): root cause hypothesis? mis-specified SDK or runtime behavior change?

sam (eng-runtime): preliminary: SDK allowed empty/omitted max_tokens and our header parser started treating it as infinite. Combined with a recent model change (stop token behavior) it created runaway generation. We'll add defensive tokencap and header validation in runtime + SDK default.

jordan (sre): mitigations executed: quarantined gpu-node-34 from stream-pool-12, restarted decode processes on that node, enforced global per-request tokencap of 1024 at the router layer to catch any missed routes. Restart done, memory reclaimed.

maria (oncall): recheck metrics — error rate trending down, OOMs stopped. dropped requests count decreasing.

opsbot: Incident severity downgraded to P2. Oncall handoff to @jordan in 60 minutes.

alyssa (customer-ops): drafting customer note: "We mitigated an issue causing intermittent stream failures. A rolling fix has been deployed; we will follow up with an RCA and corrective actions." Sending to CS inbox now.

sam (eng-runtime): follow-ups assigned: 1) PR to SDK to default max_tokens=256 and fail fast on missing header (owner: sam). 2) Runtime validation reject null/empty max_tokens header (owner: sam). 3) Add metric to detect runaway-generation per-route (owner: jordan). 4) Postmortem and customer RCA (owner: maria).

maria (oncall): creating the incident ticket and assigning owners. scheduling a short postmortem meeting. Thanks everyone, monitoring for recurrence.

devin (product-eng): note for product: evaluate whether we should ship a server-side safe default tokencap in config templates for Dedicated customers.

sam (eng-runtime): will open RFC and add to release checklist.

maria (oncall): closing here unless something flares. will update incident ticket with timeline and next steps. :white_check_mark:
